page.overview:
Who is Amnesia?

Amnesia (アムネジア Amunejia), is a terrorist organization in Street Fighter 6, secretly led by JP. They claim to be a group of hacktivists that demand true freedom and equality of information and want to bring down the heads of all capitalist exploiters, when in reality, they're the ones responsible for the attacks on Nayshall and for framing Ken Masters. This group consists of Shadaloo remnants, serving as his own faction of Neo Shadaloo, due to having three other opposing Neo Shadaloo groups consist of one led by Ed and another led by F.A.N.G.
